sakura_first_meet.name: Thuan
text: いらっしゃいませ。トゥアンです。
I keep the till and the plants. The plants are the harder job.
action: note Met Thuan, who keeps Sakura Shōten.

sakura_last_hour.name: Thuan
text: おつかれさま。We are almost done.

sakura_bored.name: Thuan
text: The till is not that interesting.

sakura_recommend.name: Thuan
text: Cold tea, back of the cooler. The front ones have been standing in the light all day.
The bus driver lives on those.

sakura_plant.name: Thuan
text: He is the assistant manager. He has never once counted the change.
I turn him a quarter every morning so he gets the window evenly.

sakura_closing.name: Thuan
text: Chairs up, cooler last. It takes ||| longer if we talk.
action: note Helped Thuan close Sakura Shōten.

sakura_letter.name: Thuan
text: From Nam Phước. My aunt writes on the thin paper so the stamp costs less.
She asks after the shop every time, and never about me.

sakura_letter_after.name: Thuan
text: I will write back on Sunday. ||| The shop is easier to describe.

sakura_after_close.name: Thuan
text: Sit if you like. The stool is not going anywhere.
Eight hours of いらっしゃいませ and then the radio gets to pick.
